subject: Phased top-up and scope rebalance — MSA & order form coordination
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cloudops.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: phased top-up plan + SOW edits

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked Redwood's latency profile. We have a short procurement window and a product change that means we want to rebalance the initial SOW: rather than taking the full committed GPU pool up-front, CloudOps would like to start at 60% of the committed capacity and then add the remainder in two phased top-ups over the next six months (month 2 and month 4).

Specifically we need: 
- An order form amendment that supports a phased top-up schedule (billing and effective dates)
- SOW edit to reflect staging plan and deliverables per phase
- A short MSA deviation that holds commercial pricing for 30 days from signature while we finish PO routing

I've attached a one-page Phase_Topup_Proposal.pdf that captures our ask. Can you engage legal and sales ops and confirm what format you prefer (amendment vs change order) and a realistic timeline for final docs + DocuSign?

Procurement contact is procurement@cloudops.com and Victor Chen (v.chen@cloudops.com) will own PO issuance.

Best,
Elaine Park
Director, Cloud Platform
CloudOps Inc.

Attachment: Phase_Topup_Proposal.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Subject: RE: Request: phased top-up plan + SOW edits (internal legal notes)

Team — reviewed Elaine's ask and the draft SOW redline. Key points and recommended approach below (see attached MSA_term_deviations_summary.pdf):

1) 30-day price hold: commercial concession. Acceptable for this deal size but should be documented as a one-time price protection limited to the order form effective date; add language that final pricing recommitment requires signature within 30 days or Redwood may revert to then-current rates.

2) Phased billing tied to milestone acceptance: acceptable. We should ensure acceptance criteria are explicit in SOW (test scenarios, SLA handover). Avoid vague language like "acceptance upon delivery."

3) Amendment vs change order: suggest a single Order Form Amendment referencing the MSA (section 4.2) that both adds the phased schedule and attaches the redlined SOW as Exhibit A. Keeps audit trail simple for billing.

4) Risk items: clarify data retention and KV cache persistence expectations during scale-ups — Dev please confirm if there is any short window where performance readjustment is expected during top-ups.

Please confirm you want me to prepare the Order Form Amendment and a short execution page we can send for DocuSign. If we proceed, I'll flag one commercial concession in the internal deal desk request: the 30-day hold.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
